elements.description: Every element by id; ids are referenced from `root` and `children`.

description: A fence body: `root` names the top-level element, `elements` holds every element by id.
title: Spec

oneOf.description: Framed container with an optional title and description.
Children laid out in one direction.
Children in `columns` equal-width columns, row by row.
Column headers and rows of strings.
One labelled figure with an optional trend.
Dated steps with a state each.
Items that are done or not.
Labelled panes; `children[i]` is the pane for `labels[i]`.
Titled sections; `children[i]` is the body of `titles[i]`.
Typed boxes and arrows: nodes, edges, optional groups (design doc 65).
Actors exchanging messages over time; every step addressable and optionally bound to code by `ref` (design doc 71 §2.4).
An aside with a variant icon: note, tip, question, important (not a severity; that is `Alert`).
A block of code with a copy button.
A passage of real code pinned to its location: `path`, 1-based `start`, marked rows, the symbol it quotes (design doc 71 §2.5).
A picture with alt text and a caption.
One value on an arc between `min` and `max`.
A tiny line of values, no axes.
Rows × columns of cells shaded by value.
A person: name, role, contact, initials avatar.
A strip of days with a marker each.
States and transitions of a lifecycle; `initial`/`final` dots, events on the arrows (design doc 123).
Entities, tables or classes with their fields and typed relations (ER / class diagram).
Steps in lanes (teams, systems), edges across lanes: a handoff or cross-functional flow.
Two graphs, before and after, over one layout; the added/removed/changed ledger is derived by id.
Bars per label, one or more series: grouped, stacked, dumbbell or horizontal.
Values over ordered labels: line, area, slope, bump or step.
Points on two numeric axes: scatter, bubble (size) or beeswarm (one axis).
Several criteria compared on spokes: radar, or polar bars for one series.
Deltas that carry a running total from a start level to an end level.
Stages narrowing from top to bottom (funnel) or widening (pyramid).
Tasks on a date scale with groups, dependencies, progress and a today line.
Items placed in a 2×2 by two 0..1 coordinates (effort/impact, urgency/importance).
Part-of-whole as nested rectangles sized by value, grouped.
Flows between staged nodes, ribbons sized by value; no cycles.
Two or three overlapping sets with labelled overlaps.
A cycle of 2–8 steps drawn clockwise around an optional hub.
Stacked horizontal layers (architecture tiers, medallion, a stack).
Stages across, rows down (does / thinks / feels), a mood line and pain points.
Cause-and-effect: an effect with categorised causes on the bones.

Element.description: One element: a catalog component (`type` + `props` on the wire) and the ids it contains.

children.description: Child element ids, in order; only containers may have any.

TableProps.description: `Table` props; every row has exactly `columns.len()` cells.

delta.description: Change text beside the value, e.g. `+3%`.

spark.description: Recent values drawn as a sparkline beside the figure.

MetricProps.description: `Metric` props; also the item shape of `MetricGrid`.

max.description: Full-bar value; default the largest item.

scale.description: `list` (default) keeps `when` as free text; `time` places items on a date axis and requires ISO `when`/`until`.

until.description: End of a span (`scale: time`): ISO date or datetime.

id.description: Unique id so boards and apps can point at this item.

ref.description: Code this item is about: `path`, `path#L10` or `path#L10-L24` (root-relative), or `block:<id>`.

oneOf.description: Items in authored order, `when` as written.
Items on a date axis; every `when` and `until` is an ISO date or datetime.

groups.description: Groups a node may belong to; drawn as a labelled box.

legend.description: Legend entries, ≤ 5: a label per state, edge style or node kind used.

id.description: Unique within the graph; referenced by edges.

group.description: Id of the group this node sits in.

ref.description: Code this node explains: `path`, `path#L10` or `path#L10-L24` (root-relative), or `block:<id>`.

sub.description: Mono second line, ≤ 40 characters: a port, a version, a capacity.

tag.description: Small rectangular tag, ≤ 12 characters: SERVICE, DB, QUEUE.

icon.description: Icon drawn before the label; the TUI prints nothing for it.

oneOf.description: Hexagon: a service or a process.
Circle: a start, an end or a point.

GraphIcon.description: `GraphNode.icon`: a closed set drawn from lucide.

state.description: Semantic state of the arrow; default default.

id.description: Unique within the graph; referenced by `GraphNode.group`.

parent.description: Id of the enclosing group (nested zones); depth ≤ 3.

kind.description: Box treatment; default zone. `boundary` draws dashed.

oneOf.description: Dashed box: a trust or network boundary.

style.description: The edge style this entry explains.

kind.description: The node kind this entry explains.

GraphLegendEntry.description: One `Graph.legend` entry: a label for a state, an edge style or a node kind.

fragments.description: Combined fragments over step index ranges, ≤ 2, disjoint, not nested.

id.description: Unique within the sequence; referenced by steps.

ref.description: Code this step runs: `path`, `path#L10` or `path#L10-L24` (root-relative), or `block:<id>`.

note.description: Note beside the step, ≤ 80 characters; ≤ 2 notes per sequence.

state.description: Semantic state of the arrow; default default.

label.description: Condition or caption in the frame's corner; ≤ 80 characters.

else.description: `alt` only: the step index where the else region starts, inside `from..=to`.

SequenceFragment.description: One `Sequence` fragment: a frame around steps `from..=to`.

oneOf.description: Something to decide or find out.

title.description: File name or caption above the block.

path.description: Root-relative file path; no `..`, no scheme.

start.description: 1-based line number of the first quoted line; default 1.

caption.description: One line under the code: the claim these lines carry.

mark.description: Marked rows as `[from, to]` line-number pairs, inclusive, inside the quoted range.

symbol.description: Name of the definition the range quotes; enables `moved` detection.

ExcerptProps.description: `Excerpt` props (design doc 71 §2.5): ≤ 120 lines and ≤ 16 KiB of `text`.

items.description: Rows in reading order; a row nests under the nearest earlier row of smaller depth.

layout.description: `list` (default) is the indented list; `nodes`/`org` draw a node tree, `nested` nested boxes.

id.description: Unique id so boards and apps can point at this row.

ref.description: Code this row is about: `path`, `path#L10` or `path#L10-L24` (root-relative), or `block:<id>`.

alt.description: What the picture shows, for readers who cannot see it.

Tag.description: One `Tags` item; the same variants as `Badge`.

values.description: Values in order, left to right.

cells.description: One row of values per row label.

max.description: Darkest-cell value; default the largest cell.

palette.description: `sequential` (default) shades from light to dark; `diverging` runs negative→neutral→positive about 0.

name.description: Full name; the avatar shows its initials.

path.description: Path; a trailing `/` or `kind: "dir"` is a folder.

rows.description: Story-map rows; cards pick one by `row` index.

cut.description: Story map: the release line is drawn after row `cut`.

limit.description: WIP limit; a column over it is marked.

id.description: Unique id so boards and apps can point at this card.

ref.description: Code this card is about: `path`, `path#L10` or `path#L10-L24` (root-relative), or `block:<id>`.

title.description: Text above the strip, e.g. the month.

states.description: States, in authored order; ≤ 40, at most one `initial`.

id.description: Unique within the machine; referenced by transitions.

sub.description: Mono second line, ≤ 40 characters: an entry action, a timeout.

ref.description: Code this state is: `path`, `path#L10` or `path#L10-L24` (root-relative), or `block:<id>`.

oneOf.description: The entry dot; at most one.

guard.description: The condition, drawn in brackets; ≤ 40 characters.

state.description: Semantic state of the arrow; default default.

detail.description: How much to show; default model.

id.description: Unique within the diagram; referenced by relations.

fields.description: Fields, in order; ≤ 32 with unique names.

ref.description: Code this entity is: `path`, `path#L10` or `path#L10-L24` (root-relative), or `block:<id>`.

name.description: Field name; unique within the entity.

sig.description: Signature after the name, e.g. `(id) -> User`.

kind.description: Cardinality or UML relation; chooses the line ends.

from_field.description: A field of `from` the line leaves.

to_field.description: A field of `to` the line enters.

direction.description: Flow direction; default LR (lanes are rows).

id.description: Unique within the diagram; referenced by `LaneStep.lane`.
Unique within the diagram; referenced by edges.

lane.description: The lane this step sits in.

ref.description: Code this step runs: `path`, `path#L10` or `path#L10-L24` (root-relative), or `block:<id>`.

oneOf.description: A parallelogram: a document or a dataset.

after.description: The graph as it is; nodes with the same id keep their place.

GraphDeltaProps.description: `GraphDelta` props (design doc 123 §4.2): ids are the identity across sides.

groups.description: Groups a node may belong to.

GraphSide.description: One side of a `GraphDelta`: a `Graph` without direction.

series.description: Series; ≤ 8, each with `labels.len()` values. `dumbbell` needs exactly 2.

state.description: Semantic state colouring the series; default default.

Series.description: One chart series: `values[i]` belongs to the i-th label or axis.

oneOf.description: Series side by side per label.
Two series as the ends of one connector per label.
Bars run left to right, labels down the side.

series.description: Series; ≤ 8, each with `labels.len()` values. `slope` needs exactly 2 labels; `bump` values are ranks ≥ 1.

oneOf.description: Two labels, one segment per series.
Ranks over time, 1 at the top.

groups.description: Point groups a point may name; ≤ 8, each a legend entry.

variant.description: Mark; default scatter. `bubble` needs `size` on every point; `beeswarm` ignores `y`.

ref.description: Code this point is about: `path`, `path#L10` or `path#L10-L24` (root-relative), or `block:<id>`.

id.description: Unique within the chart; referenced by `Point.group`.

series.description: Series; ≤ 5, each with `axes.len()` values. `polar` needs exactly 1.

max.description: Outer ring value; default the largest value.

WaterfallProps.description: `Waterfall` props (design doc 123 §4.2): the running total is computed.

value.description: A delta for `delta`; the absolute level for `total`/`subtotal`.

oneOf.description: An absolute level from the baseline.

stages.description: Stages, top to bottom; ≤ 10. Values on all or none.

today.description: The today line: ISO date or datetime.

id.description: Unique within the chart; referenced by `depends`.

group.description: Band the task sits in; equal groups are adjacent.

depends.description: Ids of tasks this one waits for.

ref.description: Code this task is about: `path`, `path#L10` or `path#L10-L24` (root-relative), or `block:<id>`.

quadrants.description: Quadrant captions, exactly 4: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right.

xTicks.description: X end labels, exactly 2: low, high.

yTicks.description: Y end labels, exactly 2: low, high.

id.description: Unique id so boards and apps can point at this item.

ref.description: Code this item is about: `path`, `path#L10` or `path#L10-L24` (root-relative), or `block:<id>`.

group.description: Group name; equal groups share a headed rectangle.

ref.description: Code this cell is about: `path`, `path#L10` or `path#L10-L24` (root-relative), or `block:<id>`.

flows.description: Flows between node ids; ≤ 48, no self-flow, no cycle.

id.description: Unique within the diagram; referenced by flows.

stage.description: Column, 0-based; derived from the flows when absent.

overlaps.description: Labelled overlaps of 2 or 3 distinct sets.

id.description: Unique within the diagram; referenced by overlaps.

sets.description: The intersecting set ids; 2 or 3, distinct.

steps.description: Steps clockwise from the top; 2 to 8.

ref.description: Code this step runs: `path`, `path#L10` or `path#L10-L24` (root-relative), or `block:<id>`.

layers.description: Layers in reading order; ≤ 12, each ≤ 12 items.

direction.description: Which way the stack reads; default top-down.

ref.description: Code this layer is: `path`, `path#L10` or `path#L10-L24` (root-relative), or `block:<id>`.

rows.description: Rows down the side; ≤ 4, each with `stages.len()` cells.

label.description: Row title, e.g. Does, Thinks, Feels.

effect.description: The effect at the head; ≤ 80 characters.

causes.description: Cause categories on the bones; ≤ 8, each ≤ 6 items.
